title: Dangerous HTTP method allowed
description: The Allow response lists a dangerous method. PUT, DELETE, TRACE, and CONNECT widen what anonymous clients can do. This check matches the method name directly.
remediation: Immediate: stop advertising methods the route does not serve, and make the server reject PUT, DELETE, TRACE and CONNECT with 405 where they are not implemented. Durable: derive the `Allow` list from the route table so it cannot drift, and disable the WebDAV or default servlet handlers that add these methods. The header proves advertisement, not reachability: confirm by sending the method and reading the status, which this passive check cannot do.
limitation: Header check: it cannot exercise the method.
